name: Capital
comment: Your seat of power. Your Capital Lv determines the construction and upgrade limits of most buildings.

name: He3 Mine
comment: Refined He3 is fuel that drives construction and sustains ship production. It also powers war ships during long expeditions and life-and-death battles in deep space.

name: Metal Extractor
comment: Metal is the foundation of every properous colony.

name: Housing District
comment: Housing Districts generate Gold through taxes. The higher the District level, the more Gold they can produce.

name: Storage Silo
comment: Stores a limited amount of He3, Metal, and Gold.

name: Academy
comment: This is where the Federation's finest Captains live and train. Captains become available for hire upon construction.

name: Guild Office
comment: Grants access to Guild-related features.

name: Shipyard
comment: Allows war ships to be manufactured on this colony. The Ship Factory's level determines the rate that ships can be manufactured.

name: Science Institute
comment: Science and technology are key to a productive and prosperous colony. This institute will help you to stay on top of cutting-edge science.

name: Research Facility
comment: Military technology is researched and developed in this facility. Upgrade this building to unlock new ships and updates to existing ship blueprints.

name: Trade Center
comment: The commercial center of every colony where goods and resources can be traded.

name: Space Station
comment: The hub of a colony. With every upgrade, new buildings are unlocked and certain building limits are raised.

name: Radar
comment: Detects resource-rich players within your vicinity as your next raid target.

name: Barricade
comment: Basic defensive structures. Creates an impassable obstacle against enemy ships until it's destroyed.

name: Particle Cannon
comment: Weapon that attacks a single fleet every Round.

name: Hydra Cannon
comment: Weapon that deals damage to a target its surrounding fleets every Round.

name: Thor's Cannon
comment: Weapon that deals damage to every fleet within a certain area every Round.

name: Monument
comment: Increases Metal Production

name: Fountain
comment: Increases He3 Production

name: Park
comment: Increases Gold Production

name: Statue
comment: Increases research speed

name: Hangar
comment: Repairs destroyed ships and scraps ships for resources.
